system.description:
The Aldorethi art of illusion out of the Silver Tower and the schools of Myllnoris and Eccria: scholarship and precision disguised as entertainment.

  • Precise Focus: Advantage on Fortitude saves to keep an illusion going while attacked, damaged or grappled.
    • 9th level: on saves to keep any spell going, not only illusions.
  • Tower Insight: Advantage to identify or counter another illusionist's work, and on Arcane Analysis for Aldorethi illusions.
